text:
maya: Kickoff for a short "launch loop" drip — three emails over two weeks targeting our alpha cohort. Goal: convert early adopters to trials + webinar signups.

ben: Segments: alpha_clicks (clicked demo/docs), passive_subs (newsletter-only), accounts_50plus (company emails, >50 emp). Need suppressions for recent unsubscribes.

sarah: Cadence: E0 (welcome + what to expect, day 0), E1 (deep-dive snippet + metric, day 4), E2 (invite to 'Launch Loop' webinar + book 1:1, day 12).

diego: Subject tests for E0: "You're in the alpha cohort — next steps" vs "Welcome — quick setup for alpha users". Run on alpha_clicks only.

maya: E1 should include a tiny inline chart (png) showing latency vs baseline and a 1-line customer quote. Keep images <120KB.

ben: For dev audiences add a curl snippet in E1:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Put that only in alpha_clicks copy.

sarah: UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_loop_alpha, utm_content={segment}. Track: open, click, webinar_reg, trial_started.

ops-bot: reminder set: draft due Fri EOD in #marketing. :bell: 

maya: Owners: ben = segment export + suppressions, sarah = copy + subject tests, diego = send ops (Braze). I'll own creative.

ben: CSV format: email,segment,company,company_size,intent_score,signup_ts. ETA tomorrow 10am to #marketing-assets.

diego: Send windows: alpha_clicks Tue 9am PT, passive_subs Wed 2pm PT, accounts_50plus Mon 11am PT. Enterprise calendar link = https://cal.redwood.ai/enterprise?utm_medium=email

maya: Rollout: phase A = alpha_clicks (~2.5k). Send E0 -> hold 24h -> if open >= 14% continue, else swap subject and resend. Expand if click >= 3%.

sarah: Suppression rules: exclude unsubscribed in last 90d, bounces, internal domains, and anyone who already started a trial.

ben: Measurement: create cohort launch_loop_alpha_cohort for funnel analysis (email -> webinar_reg -> trial) and monitor at 7/14 days.

maya: Copy constraints: each email <120 words, single CTA button, include plain-text fallback for deliverability.

diego: I'll build the Braze flow and post the test send metrics here after phase A. thanks all! :rocket:
